summary: The proof is complete and matches the stated nonfinal claim. Each selector is formed on distinct physical bases after aggregating collisions, its calibration weights satisfy the endpoint capacity bound, and no selector scores are added. The strengthened hard selector bound, all strict constants, the integer rounding to r_int^c >= 10, the quotient-rank estimate, the intrinsic-rank aliases, and both directions of the defect screen are valid, including singleton and equality boundary cases.
